title: Nutty Crispy Jamaican Ackee Fritters
description: Salty and crispy Jamaican dish featuring ackee and amaretti, perfect for a brunch mood, infused with oil and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ackee, crushed amaretti cookies, infused oil, chopped onion, and chopped scotch bonnet pepper.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour and a pinch of salt.
Dip each ackee mixture ball into the flour mixture, then the beaten egg, and finally the flour mixture again.
Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the coated ackee mixture balls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Nutty Crispy Jamaican Ackee Fritters hot and enjoy.
